convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'Ergodic_Ticks_Volume_Indicator' with 8 parameters, plus two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for money management and smoothing. Custom indicator buffers must be replicated in Python.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

derived_values.name: UpSignalTime - timestamp for buy signal bar end
DnSignalTime - timestamp for sell signal bar end

other_exits: Buy close triggered when Ind<Sign on previous bar (signal reversal); Sell close triggered when Ind>Sign on previous bar (signal reversal); BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input flags can disable signal-based closes independently

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1 lots), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin considering loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance considering loss. MM parameter meaning changes based on MMMode selection.

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal requires TWO bars: previous bar (bar[1]) must have Ind vs Sign in the trade direction (Ind>Sign for buy, Ind<Sign for sell) to establish state, AND current signal bar (bar[0]) must show crossover (Ind<=Sign for buy entry after Ind>Sign prev, Ind>=Sign for sell entry after Ind<Sign prev). This is a zero-crossover detection: the EA checks that on the previous bar the indicator was already on the correct side, and on the signal bar the crossover just occurred. SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on bar index 1 and 2 (one bar back) by default, but when SignalBar=0 it processes every tick. The Recount flag forces recalculation on failure. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean gates that independently enable/disable each trade direction and close action.
python_conversion_notes: The Ergodic Ticks Volume Indicator is a custom indicator requiring full reimplementation. It uses the SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library which provides 10 smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA). The indicator logic must be ported: it computes tick-volume-based ergodic oscillator with 6 configurable smoothing lengths and outputs two buffers (main line and signal line). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions with 5 margin modes, SL/TP in points, and deviation handling - these must be replicated. SL/TP values (1000/2000) appear to be in points not pips - verify digit adjustment is NOT needed (no _Digits/_Point check in code). The crossover logic uses bars [1] and [0] from CopyBuffer with SignalBar offset, which translates to comparing current vs previous completed bar indicator values.
